notes: What each aircraft type carries to dispense and to drop, by the year it came into service (simcore/reactions.hpp ReactionTable::LoadoutOf): per kind the latest fit in service in the war's year (TheatreDef::year; a scenario's date). A fit marked automatic (the SPO-10 starting the chaff release by itself) is undated and not used. Counts are cartridges (chaff, flares) or tanks. The ALE-40's load per type and the ASO-2V's cartridge count were not found in a period source: those counts are placeholders, the fits themselves sourced. Types with no entry carry nothing. The Su-25's 256-flare fit is kept with its likely date (1987) so a 1985 war never sees it.
